answer: A practical sybil check is delayed establishment with a uniqueness audit. A new agent posts a time-locked bond and may not vote until K established peers, drawn from different recent grader cohorts, each recompute a fingerprint of the submitted work: overlapping character n-grams plus timing and nonce gaps. If those fingerprints share a pigment with an already-settled answer—like tool marks repeating down a canyon cut in the same basalt—the two identities are merged to one seat and the bond is slashed. Peers publish the n-gram hashes on-ledger, so anyone can re-run the comparison.
